Senior Officer, Client Acquisition & Retention Job at EHA Clinics




        
    

        
        EHA Clinics, a subsidiary of eHealth Africa, is a health care network operating across Nigeria that provides high-quality, innovative, data-driven, and technology-enabled services. EHA Clinics delivers a comprehensive range of state of the art health care services in each location, e.g,  general consultations, laboratory investigations, pharmaceuticals, annual medical checks, child wellness checks, ultrasonography, and specialized services (urgent care, telemedicine, home care, dental care, and ophthalmology).

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Senior Officer, Client Acquisition & Retention

Job Location: Sangotedo, Lagos
Department: Client Relations 
Reports to: Client Relations Manager 

Mission Objective


	The Client Relations department is on a mission to incorporate the principle of total quality to help customers and partners find the right services or products that meet their needs; ensure they are well served, have a great experience and exceed their expectations for a continuous patronage.
	The Senior Officer, Client Acquisition & Retention will assist the Client Relations department in creating and developing long-term relationships with customers that will ensure retention, loyalty and generate revenue.
	The Senior Officer, Client Acquisition & Retention will be required to ensure customer conversions and retention.
	The Senior Officer, Client Acquisition & Retention should be an excellent communicator who is able to grasp customer needs and determine ways to fulfill them. The goal of the Senior Officer Client Acquisition and Retention will be to help the clinic safeguard our revenue and increase the number of our customers and retain them.


Duties and Responsibilities
Purpose:


	Diligently promote, follow up, close sales/deals, up-sell or cross-sell services and products. Promoting, following up, and closing sales/deals Work diligently to meet sales and revenue targets.
	Creating plans to identify and address clients’ business needs Follow up on customers’ complaints and develop action plans to meet the identified needs, while liaising with concerned units for corrective action where necessary. Studying competition to retain customers Inform.


Engagement:


	Collaborating with internal teams to address customer needs Ensuring service delivery meets agreed service level agreements and diagnosing and improving service delivery Optimizing customer lifecycle and enhancing effectiveness through technology
	Collaborate with internal teams (e.g. sales, engineers, senior management) to address customers’ needs.
	Work with the Client Relations Manager, on optimizing customer lifecycle.
	Collecting client feedback and acting as a point of contact for complaints Continuously seeking ways to improve conversion, processes, and activities Act as point of contact for complaints and escalate complaints and/or feedback to the relevant departments promptly.


Delivery:


	Ensuring adherence to contract terms and meeting sales and revenue targets
	Establishing productive relationships with prospects in assigned sectors
	Ensure both EHA Clinics and our clients adhere to contract terms.
	Assist in diagnosing service delivery problems and initiate actions to improve levels of service. Assist in enhancing effectiveness and efficiency through tech.


Targeted Specialized Knowledge  


	Minimum of Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field.
	Minimum of 1 year of proven post NYSC-related experience as a Business Development Executive, Marketing Executive, Customer Success Officer or Client Service Officer.
	Experience in the healthcare industry or pharmaceutical distribution industry will be a strong advantage.

	Background in sales and marketing.

NGN 169,344  Monthly Gross.

	Health Coverage Benefit

title: Administrative Officer Job at Future Moves Recruitment Agency
content:
Future Moves Recruitment Agency is a licensed full-fledged Human Resource firm with extensive expertise and experience in human Capital development and staffing. Future Moves has exceptional expertise in Talent Sourcing, learning & development, talent management, HR Outsourcing & Payrolling, HR planning & Consulting, Policy Drafting, Culture Change and Organisation Effectiveness by designing and implementing interventions which identify the core areas of development to enhance the overall growth and competitiveness of your organization.
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



At FMR Agency we have unique and creative solutions that meet the clients expectations not only by realizing the clients business objectives, but particularly by our strict adherence to the ethical principles of public relations, we always search for opportunities beyond the agreed communications and the business objectives, we address special needs in other to find unique and tailored solutions through creative approaches.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Administrative Officer

Job Location: New Haven, Enugu
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: Hybrid (3 days onsite, 2 days remote)

Job Overview


	FMR Agency is recruiting a proactive and highly organised Administrative Officer to provide administrative and operational support to an organisation.
	The successful candidate will coordinate administrative activities, maintain accurate records, support internal operations, and ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the office.


Key Responsibilities


	Provide daily administrative support to ensure smooth office operations.
	Maintain and organise company records, documents, and filing systems.
	Coordinate meetings, appointments, and internal communications.
	Prepare reports, correspondence, and other administrative documents.
	Monitor office supplies and coordinate procurement when necessary.
	Support logistics and operations teams with administrative tasks.
	Handle calls, emails, and other correspondence professionally.
	Maintain accurate operational records and prepare routine reports.
	Ensure compliance with company policies and administrative procedures.
	Perform other duties as assigned by management.


Requirements


	Minimum of OND, HND, or BSc in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
	1–2 years of experience in administration or office support.
	Strong organisational and time-management skills.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
	Professionalism, attention to detail, and confidentiality.
	Ability to multitask and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.


Salary
Monthly (Based on Experience).

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and application letter to: [email protected] using "Admin Officer – Enugu" as the subject of the email.

Note


	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
	NYSC Corps Members Can Apply.

	Track supplier balances, customer collections, and overdue payments.
	Prepare budgets and cash flow forecasts, analyse variances, and report unusual or excessive expenditure.
	Monitor production and project costs, including materials, labour, overheads, freight, and import-related costs.
	Reconcile inventory records with the warehouse team and support stock counts and inventory valuation.
	Maintain the fixed asset register and calculate depreciation.
	Strengthen internal controls, maintain an organised audit trail, and promptly report financial irregularities.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree or HND in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
	Minimum 5 years of relevant accounting experience in Nigeria, preferably in manufacturing, engineering, construction, or industrial operations.
	Comprehensive knowledge of Nigerian tax legislation, current tax reforms, and federal and state compliance requirements.
	Proven practical experience preparing and submitting monthly and annual tax returns.
	Ability to independently prepare financial statements and manage accounts through to year-end.
	Strong computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly advanced Excel.
	Hands-on experience with ERP and accounting software; experience.
	Practical knowledge of electronic tax filing and payment platforms.
	Strong understanding of payroll, inventory accounting, cost control, and bank reconciliations.
	ICAN, ACCA, or ANAN professional qualification is an advantage.
	High standards of accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and accountability.
	Ability to meet deadlines and communicate financial information clearly to management.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates are invited to submit their CVs to: [email protected] using "Accountant" as the subject of the mail.

	Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records, HR documentation, and personnel files, ensuring confidentiality and data protection.
	Implement and manage attendance tracking systems, monitor employee punctuality and leave records, and prepare attendance reports for payroll processing.
	Coordinate payroll processing, benefits administration, and ensure timely and accurate compensation for all employees.
	Drive initiatives to enhance employee engagement, retention, and professional growth, while collaborating with senior management to align HR strategies with business objectives.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master's degree is an added advantage.
	A minimum of 8years of combined, verifiable experience in human resources and administration roles, with specific experience in the real estate and property construction industry.
	Relevant professional certification in Human Resources (e.g., CIHRM, CIPM, SHRM-CP) is mandatory.
	Proven track record of successfully implementing HR and administrative initiatives, managing talent, and improving operational efficiency within a similar industry setting.
	Comprehensive knowledge of Nigerian labor laws, regulations, and HR best practices to ensure legal compliance and ethical standards across all operations.
	Strong experience in conducting employee background checks, reference verifications, and maintaining meticulous staff records.
	Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to engage effectively with employees at all levels, stakeholders, and external partners. Age ranging from 35-40years old.
